name: aida_r5_lab_pill_pack
purpose: the user's task (2026-10-17): a pill vial packed one tablet at a time with tweezers. The R5 takes the tweezers out of their cradle in a tripod on their cushion grips (stage 1), then - planned live from the tweezers as they sit in its hand - closes their tips on a tablet, lifts it, carries it over the open vial and lets it drop in (tool_tip_place)

environment.why: the generated laboratory (scripts/make_lab_env.py - run it first): benches at the dining table's measured top (0.708 m) and front edge, where the R5's grasps and place pass; the open Euro-container bin and the operator desk

fixtures.name: TweezerCradle
fixtures.why: two posts holding the tweezers on edge 45 mm up (the open fingers reach below the pinch: at 25 mm they met the bench), one at the root, one at the tips' end - the 10 cm between them free for the hand (a post 28 mm from the grip met the open fingers); walls either side of each post keep them standing

fixtures.name: TabletStands
fixtures.why: each tablet on a 30 mm stand 4 cm up: with the tweezers' tips 15 cm out from the palm, a tablet flat on the bench left no grasp (the hand's outer fingers in the bench in every orientation the arm reached); 4 cm up, all six spots surveyed plan (2026-10-17)

objects.name: Tweezers
objects.label: the tweezers
objects.why: make_pill_kit.py's 115 mm tweezers (spring arms proved on the rig) on edge in the cradle, root toward -x, tips toward +x

objects.name: Vial
objects.label: the open pill vial
objects.why: the 30-dram vial standing open (its cap off) for the tablets

grasp_plan.why: a precision pinch, thumb against index, across both arms 55 mm out from the root (the grip a person takes, short of the tips), its closing axis held within 10 deg of the arms' opening axis; lifted 5 cm out of the cradle
grasp_plan.tripod_why: thumb against index and middle side by side: a two-point pinch let the tweezers turn about the pinch line and fall back into the cradle at the lift (their centre of mass ~2 cm off the grip, ~4x the pads' torsional friction)
grasp_plan.grip_free_radius_why: the tripod's three pads and the open fingers round the grip: 2 cm left the tool's own cells under the index
grasp_plan.finger_row_tolerance_why: the hand's pinch axis is ~18 deg off square to its finger row: no roll brings the row nearer the tool (12 deg left no grasp); the middle's own flexion, matched along the pinch axis, puts both pads on the face

grasp_replay.why: the planned chess move (plan_er_grasp.py, task pinch_place)
grasp_replay.controller_why: HomeHero's recordings and planner paths are commands to its R5 action layer (gravity-compensated arm targets, gravity feed-forward elsewhere); plain targets leave the shoulder slide 7.5 mm under its target (7.6 kg on 10 kN/m)

hand_model.why: the halt (word 007) set above the force band, 8.0 V, so the position loop governs the squeeze: at the 3.0 V default the index stalls at about 3 N, the band's floor, and could tighten no further. Driven by the grip command alone this pinch failed every way: at 3.0 V the thumb flicked the 14 g pawn out before it stalled; at 1.0 V with 0.8 V post-contact the digits crept closed during the carry and rolled it out at 61 deg; at 1.0 V with 0 V the stored 2.4 N drained in half a second of lift

grip.why: a hold, not a squeeze: 14.6 g of tweezers needs ~0.1 N a pad with friction; at 0.4-1.2 N an arm moves < 0.3 mm (its spring 1440 N/m at 55 mm), the tips stay open for the tablet stages

squeeze.why: the thumb pressed to 3.5-5 N against index and middle (held where they are): at the cushion grips (55 mm out) ~3.2 N closes the tips 4 mm a side onto an 8 mm tablet (their 16 mm rest gap), the rest presses it (~0.5 N a tip; it weighs 0.2 g). One digit banded: three banded against each other - the thumb carrying both fingers' share - chase each other

grasp_replay.then_why: the tool's tips take the tablet, planned live from where the tweezers sit in the hand: first to over the tablet, then - looked at again there - the hand only moved so the tips' midpoint is over it, straight down, closed, carried and let go (tool_tip_then.py --correct). Planned once at the hold, the tweezers shifted in the light grip on the way and the tips closed on nothing; re-planned in full from over the tablet, the hand re-staged and the tips met the round tablet 2 mm off its centre line and squirted it out

payload.why: the tablet the tips take, and the vial it is packed into (the replay's PACK verdict: inside its cavity, carried, let go)

tool_tip_place.why: the tablet lifted 11 cm (clear of the vial's 91 mm rim), carried over the vial's mouth, lowered to 15 mm above it and let go; the squeeze itself is the force band's (grasp_replay.grip.squeeze)
